articles.title: Latvia could host nuclear weapons if NATO chooses to deploy them, president says
articles.description: Nuclear weapons could be stationed in Latvia if NATO decides to do so and the need arises, Latvian President Edgars Rinkēvičs said.

articles.title: Vietnam evacuates injured sailor from abandoned MSC containership
articles.description: Vietnam evacuates an unconscious sailor from MSC Hermes III after suspected toxic gas exposure, a week after its 25 crew abandoned ship.
